about: ONE FEATURE LIST FOR BOTH APPS (WP-50 / M46, the Founder's ask of 2026-11-20): every unit of the VRG Desktop (launcher/vrg-catalog.json, all levels, categories aside) and every feature of VRG Mobile (Catalogue.ALL in Mobile/android/kit-core/.../Feature.kt) shows on BOTH apps. `desk` says how each Desktop unit is on the phone, `phone` how each phone feature is on the Desktop. full = it opens and works there (phone: native = a phone screen, webapp = the same HTML app offline, pc = through the paired relay); grey = it makes no sense on that device: the tile is greyed out and a click shows only its description; gap = it should work there and does not yet: the tile shows its description and the work package that builds it. tools/parity.js checks it (every unit and feature named once, every target real) and writes Dashboard/config/phone-cards.json (the Desktop's phone tiles) and the table in docs/mobile/PARITY.md; Mobile/catalogue/desk-gen.js turns `desk` into the phone's DeskCatalog.kt. A new unit or feature on either side needs its line here in the same change.

states.webapp: ugyanaz a HTML alkalmazás a telefonon, offline
states.pc: a párosított PC-n át, a relén keresztül
states.grey: ezen az eszközön nincs értelme: szürke, csak a leírás nyílik meg
states.gap: ide is kell, még nincs kész: a leírás és a munkacsomag nyílik meg
